261	    def _plan_route(
262	        self, robot: Robot, task: Task, start: Position | None = None
263	    ) -> list[Position] | None:
264	        """Shortest current->pickup->dropoff route, or None if unreachable.
265	
266	        *start* overrides the robot's current position, which is how sidestep
267	        candidates are evaluated without moving the robot first.
268	        """
269	        origin = robot.position if start is None else start
270	        try:
271	            if not task.picked_up:
272	                if origin == task.pickup:
273	                    to_pickup: list[Position] = []
274	                else:
275	                    to_pickup = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.pickup)
276	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
277	            else:
278	                # Goods are already on board: a reclosed pickup cell must not
279	                # pull the robot back.
280	                to_pickup = []
281	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.dropoff)
282	        except ValueError:
283	            return None
284	        return to_pickup + to_dropoff
285	
286	    def _reroute_after_map_change(self) -> None:
287	        for task in self.tasks.values():
288	            if task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
289	                continue
290	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
291	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
292	                continue
293	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
294	            if route is None:
295	                robot.route = []
296	                self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
297	            else:
298	                # Only the route is refreshed here; pickup/delivery are
299	                # confirmed at step start (or were already recorded).
300	                robot.route = route
301	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
302	
303	    def _recover_paused_tasks(self) -> None:
304	        """Resume tasks suspended by map unreachability where possible."""
305	        for task_id in sorted(self.paused_tasks):
306	            task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
307	            if task is None or task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
308	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
309	                continue
310	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
311	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
312	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
313	                continue
314	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
315	            if route is None:
316	                robot.route = []
317	                continue
318	            robot.route = route
319	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
320	            self._finish_if_arrived(robot)

326	    def _route_cells(self, exclude_id: str) -> set[Position]:
327	        """Cells every robot except *exclude_id* still plans to drive through."""
328	        cells: set[Position] = set()
329	        for robot in self.robots.values():
330	            if robot.robot_id != exclude_id:
331	                cells.update(robot.route)
332	        return cells

334	    def _idle_sidestep_cell(
335	        self,
336	        blocker: Robot,
337	        requester: Robot,
338	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
339	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
340	    ) -> Position | None:
341	        """Free side-cell an idle blocker can yield to, or None.
342	
343	        The target may not be the requester's own cell (that would swap the
344	        two robots within one tick) nor any cell another robot still plans to
345	        drive through, so the blocker never trades one blockage for another.
346	        """
347	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=blocker.robot_id)
348	        for cell in self.grid.neighbors(blocker.position):
349	            if cell == requester.position:
350	                continue
351	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved:
352	                continue
353	            if cell in on_routes:
354	                continue
355	            return cell
356	        return None

358	    def _self_sidestep(
359	        self,
360	        robot: Robot,
361	        task: Task | None,
362	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
363	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
364	        already_moved: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
365	    ) -> tuple[Position, list[Position]] | None:
366	        """Best side cell plus replanned route for a blocked robot, or None.
367	
368	        Only cells off every other robot's planned route qualify, and only if
369	        the task remains reachable from there. A candidate that merely retreats
370	        along the corridor only to face the very same blocker again on the next
371	        tick is rejected too: such a move records mileage and gets undone
372	        forever instead of making progress, even when more empty cells stretch
373	        out behind the robot. Candidates are ranked by replanned route length
374	        with the deterministic neighbor order (up, left, right, down) breaking
375	        ties. *already_moved* names robots that have used their one move of
376	        this tick and therefore cannot vacate a cell to resolve the block.
377	        """
378	        if task is None or task.completed:
379	            return None
380	        destination = robot.route[0]
381	        blocker_id = occupied.get(destination)
382	        if blocker_id is None:
383	            blocker_id = reserved.get(destination)
384	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=robot.robot_id)
385	        best: tuple[int, int, Position, list[Position]] | None = None
386	        for index, cell in enumerate(self.grid.neighbors(robot.position)):
387	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved or cell in on_routes:
388	                continue
389	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task, start=cell)
390	            if route is None:
391	                continue
392	            if (
393	                blocker_id is not None
394	                and blocker_id != robot.robot_id
395	                and self._is_bounceback_retreat(
396	                    robot, cell, route, blocker_id, occupied, reserved, already_moved
397	                )
398	            ):
399	                # The replanned route immediately returns through the cell the
400	                # robot is vacating and the blocker cannot use that opening to
401	                # leave: the move would be undone on the next tick.
402	                continue
403	            if best is None or (len(route), index) < (best[0], best[1]):
404	                best = (len(route), index, cell, route)
405	        if best is None:
406	            return None
407	        return best[2], best[3]
408	
409	    def _is_bounceback_retreat(
410	        self,
411	        robot: Robot,
412	        side: Position,
413	        replanned: Sequence[Position],
414	        blocker_id: str,
415	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
416	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
417	        already_moved: frozenset[str],
418	    ) -> bool:
419	        """Whether stepping to *side* only sends the robot back to the block.
420	
421	        A retreat is futile when the replanned route leads straight back through
422	        the robot's current cell and still runs through the blocker's cell (so
423	        the side move is undone next tick with the same blocker ahead) while
424	        the blocker cannot leave its own cell through the gap that opens up.
425	        A route that bypasses the blocker entirely is a genuine detour and is
426	        never rejected here.
427	        """
428	        if not replanned or replanned[0] != robot.position:
429	            return False
430	        blocker = self.robots.get(blocker_id)
431	        if blocker is None or blocker.position not in replanned:
432	            return False
433	        # Hypothetical end-of-tick layout: the requester has vacated its cell
434	        # and stands on the candidate side cell.
435	        hyp_occupied = dict(occupied)
436	        del hyp_occupied[robot.position]
437	        hyp_occupied[side] = robot.robot_id
438	        # The requester only gets back onto its route by driving through these
439	        # cells, so a blocker may only "leave" by driving on, never by parking
440	        # on the replanned route. The requester cannot make a second move
441	        # within this tick, and neither can a robot that already moved.
442	        blocked_path = frozenset(replanned)
443	        return not self._can_vacate(
444	            blocker,
445	            robot,
446	            hyp_occupied,
447	            reserved,
448	            frozenset({robot.robot_id}) | already_moved,
449	            blocked_path,
450	        )
451	
452	    def _can_vacate(
453	        self,
454	        blocker: Robot,
455	        requester: Robot,
456	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
457	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
458	        checking: frozenset[str],
459	        blocked_path: frozenset[Position],
460	    ) -> bool:
461	        """Whether *blocker* can leave its cell this tick in the given layout.
462	
463	        An idle blocker leaves only by yielding onto a safe side cell for the
464	        requesting robot; a busy blocker leaves by driving onto its next
465	        waypoint (possibly following a chain of robots that all move this tick)
466	        or by sidestepping onto a free adjacent cell itself. Robots paused by
467	        map unreachability never move. *checking* names robots whose leave
468	        check is already on the call stack, so a cyclic dependency (a head-on
469	        deadlock, or the requester itself) is not assumed resolvable.
470	        *blocked_path* holds the cells the retreating requester must drive back
471	        through: another robot parking there only moves the blockage, so such
472	        sidesteps do not count as leaving (driving on along the cell on the
473	        blocker's own route does).
474	        """
475	        if blocker.robot_id in checking:
476	            return False
477	        task = self.tasks[blocker.task_id] if blocker.task_id is not None else None
478	        if task is not None and task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
479	            return False
480	        if task is not None and not blocker.route:
481	            # A busy robot with no route left only arrives/finishes this tick;
482	            # it never drives or sidesteps for anyone.
483	            return False
484	        if task is None:
485	            # Idle robots only ever move by yielding for a requester.
486	            side = self._idle_sidestep_cell(blocker, requester, occupied, reserved)
487	            return side is not None and side not in blocked_path
488	        if blocker.route:
489	            ahead = blocker.route[0]
490	            if (
491	                self.grid.traversable(ahead)
492	                and ahead not in occupied
493	                and ahead not in reserved
494	            ):
495	                return True
496	            occupant_id = occupied.get(ahead) or reserved.get(ahead)
497	            if (
498	                occupant_id is not None
499	                and occupant_id != blocker.robot_id
500	                and occupant_id not in checking
501	            ):
502	                # The blocker could follow the robot ahead once that robot
503	                # vacates its cell this same tick.
504	                if self._can_vacate(
505	                    self.robots[occupant_id],
506	                    requester,
507	                    occupied,
508	                    reserved,
509	                    checking | {blocker.robot_id},
510	                    blocked_path,
511	                ):
512	                    return True
513	        # Otherwise the blocker might sidestep onto a free side cell itself,
514	        # but not onto a cell the retreating requester still has to use.
515	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=blocker.robot_id)
516	        for side_cell in self.grid.neighbors(blocker.position):
517	            if (
518	                side_cell in occupied
519	                or side_cell in reserved
520	                or side_cell in on_routes
521	                or side_cell in blocked_path
522	            ):
523	                continue
524	            if self._plan_route(blocker, task, start=side_cell) is not None:
525	                return True
526	        return False
527	
528	    def _update_traffic_waits(self, blocked_by: dict[str, str]) -> None:
529	        """Accumulate consecutive waits; any other outcome resets the counter."""
530	        for robot_id in list(self._traffic_waits):
531	            if robot_id not in blocked_by:
532	                del self._traffic_waits[robot_id]
533	        for robot_id, blocker_id in blocked_by.items():
534	            entry = self._traffic_waits.get(robot_id)
535	            if entry is None:
536	                self._traffic_waits[robot_id] = {"blocked_by": [blocker_id], "ticks": 1}
537	            else:
538	                entry["blocked_by"] = [blocker_id]
539	                entry["ticks"] = int(entry["ticks"]) + 1
540	
541	    def _reconcile_traffic_waits_after_map_change(self) -> None:
542	        """Drop wait records an accepted map edit has invalidated.
543	
544	        A map change never moves a robot, so it can neither create a wait nor
545	        add to one; but it can end one. A robot whose task just paused on
546	        unreachability has no route left to wait on, and a robot whose
547	        replanned next cell is no longer held by the recorded blocker is not
548	        blocked by it anymore -- both records are removed. An entry whose
549	        robot still faces the very same blocker on its refreshed route keeps
550	        its count untouched, whatever else the edit changed.
551	        """
552	        occupied = {robot.position: robot.robot_id for robot in self.robots.values()}
553	        for robot_id, entry in list(self._traffic_waits.items()):
554	            robot = self.robots.get(robot_id)
555	            if robot is None or not robot.route:
556	                del self._traffic_waits[robot_id]
557	                continue
558	            if occupied.get(robot.route[0]) not in entry["blocked_by"]:
559	                del self._traffic_waits[robot_id]
560	
561	    def _traffic_wait_report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
562	        return [
563	            {
564	                "robot_id": robot_id,
565	                "blocked_by": list(entry["blocked_by"]),
566	                "ticks": entry["ticks"],
567	            }
568	            for robot_id, entry in sorted(self._traffic_waits.items())
569	        ]

575	    def assign_tasks(self) -> None:
576	        """Assign pending tasks to the nearest idle robot using stable tie breaks."""
577	        pending = [task for task in self.tasks.values() if task.assigned_robot is None]
578	        for task in sorted(pending, key=lambda item: item.task_id):
579	            choices: list[tuple[int, str, list[tuple[int, int]]]] = []
580	            for robot in self.robots.values():
581	                if not robot.idle:
582	                    continue
583	                try:
584	                    route = shortest_path(self.grid, robot.position, task.pickup)
585	                    route += shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
586	                except ValueError:
587	                    continue
588	                choices.append((len(route), robot.robot_id, route))
589	            if not choices:
590	                # No robot can reach this task yet; it keeps waiting and does
591	                # not block assignment of other tasks.
592	                continue
593	            _, robot_id, route = min(choices)
594	            robot = self.robots[robot_id]
595	            robot.task_id = task.task_id
596	            robot.route = route
597	            task.assigned_robot = robot_id
598	
599	    def _confirm_pickups(self) -> None:
600	        """A robot starting a tick on its pickup point collects first."""
601	        for robot in self.robots.values():
602	            if robot.task_id is None:
603	                continue
604	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
605	            if not task.completed and not task.picked_up and robot.position == task.pickup:
606	                task.picked_up = True
607	
608	    def step(self) -> dict[str, object]:
609	        self._confirm_pickups()
610	        self._recover_paused_tasks()
611	        self.assign_tasks()
612	        # A robot assigned while already standing on the pickup cell collects
613	        # immediately instead of driving off without the goods.
614	        self._confirm_pickups()
615	        occupied = {robot.position: robot.robot_id for robot in self.robots.values()}
616	        reserved: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
617	        moved: list[str] = []
618	        moved_ids: set[str] = set()
619	        blocked_by: dict[str, str] = {}
620	
621	        def relocate(robot: Robot, destination: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
622	            del occupied[robot.position]
623	            robot.position = destination
624	            robot.distance_travelled += 1
625	            occupied[destination] = robot.robot_id
626	            reserved[destination] = robot.robot_id
627	            moved.append(robot.robot_id)
628	            moved_ids.add(robot.robot_id)
629	
630	        for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id):
631	            if robot.robot_id in moved_ids:
632	                # Already yielded this tick at another robot's request.
633	                continue
634	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id] if robot.task_id is not None else None
635	            if task is not None and task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
636	                # Paused by map unreachability: stays put, never yields.
637	                continue
638	            if not robot.route:
639	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
640	                continue
641	            destination = robot.route[0]
642	            if not self.grid.traversable(destination):
643	                # Defensive: routes are normally replanned on every map edit.
644	                if task is not None and not task.completed:
645	                    route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
646	                    if route is None:
647	                        robot.route = []
648	                        self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
649	                    else:
650	                        robot.route = route
651	                continue
652	            blocker_id = occupied.get(destination)
653	            if blocker_id is None:
654	                blocker_id = reserved.get(destination)
655	            if blocker_id is None or blocker_id == robot.robot_id:
656	                relocate(robot, destination)
657	                robot.route.pop(0)
658	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
659	                continue
660	            # Another robot is in the way; this is distinct from a
661	            # map-unreachability pause and the task stays active.
662	            blocker = self.robots[blocker_id]
663	            if blocker_id not in moved_ids:
664	                if blocker.task_id is None:
665	                    # Idle blocker: ask it to yield onto a free side cell,
666	                    # then take over the cell it vacated.
667	                    side = self._idle_sidestep_cell(blocker, robot, occupied, reserved)
668	                    if side is not None:
669	                        relocate(blocker, side)
670	                        relocate(robot, destination)
671	                        robot.route.pop(0)
672	                        self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
673	                        continue
674	                elif blocker.route:
675	                    ahead = blocker.route[0]
676	                    if (
677	                        self.grid.traversable(ahead)
678	                        and ahead not in occupied
679	                        and ahead not in reserved
680	                    ):
681	                        # The blocker is expected to drive on within this
682	                        # tick, so waiting one tick is cheaper than detouring.
683	                        blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
684	                        continue
685	            # The blocker cannot or will not move this tick: try to sidestep
686	            # onto a free adjacent cell and replan from there.
687	            side = self._self_sidestep(
688	                robot, task, occupied, reserved, frozenset(moved_ids)
689	            )
690	            if side is not None:
691	                cell, route = side
692	                relocate(robot, cell)
693	                robot.route = route
694	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
695	                continue
696	            blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
697	        self._update_traffic_waits(blocked_by)
698	        self.tick += 1
699	        event: dict[str, object] = {
700	            "type": "tick",
701	            "tick": self.tick,
702	            "moved": moved,
703	            "robots": {robot_id: list(robot.position) for robot_id, robot in sorted(self.robots.items())},
704	            "completed": sorted(task.task_id for task in self.tasks.values() if task.completed),
705	        }
706	        self.replay.append(event)
707	        return event
708	
709	    def _finish_if_arrived(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
710	        if robot.task_id is None:
711	            return
712	        task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
713	        if task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
714	            return
715	        if robot.position == task.pickup:
716	            task.picked_up = True
717	        if task.picked_up and robot.position == task.dropoff and not robot.route:
718	            task.completed = True
719	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
720	            robot.task_id = None
721	
722	    def metrics(self) -> dict[str, object]:
723	        completed = sum(task.completed for task in self.tasks.values())
724	        return {
725	            "ticks": self.tick,
726	            "tasks_total": len(self.tasks),
727	            "tasks_completed": completed,
728	            "tasks_paused": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
729	            "completion_ratio": completed / len(self.tasks) if self.tasks else 1.0,
730	            "distance_total": sum(robot.distance_travelled for robot in self.robots.values()),
731	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
732	        }
733

735	        """Obstacles, map-unreachability pauses and per-robot traffic waits."""

737	            "tick": self.tick,
738	            "width": self.grid.width,
739	            "height": self.grid.height,
740	            "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.grid.obstacles)],
741	            "paused_tasks": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
742	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),

762	    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
763	        """Write the simulator state to *path* without changing this instance.
764	
765	        The write is atomic: an existing destination keeps either its complete
766	        old contents or the complete new contents, and a brand-new destination
767	        is either fully created or left absent. Filesystem or permission errors
768	        raise :class:`OSError`.
769	        """
770	        document = {
771	            "version": CHECKPOINT_VERSION,
772	            "grid": {
773	                "width": self.grid.width,
774	                "height": self.grid.height,
775	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.grid.obstacles)],
776	            },
777	            "base_grid": {
778	                "width": self.base_grid.width,
779	                "height": self.base_grid.height,
780	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.base_grid.obstacles)],
781	            },
782	            "tick": self.tick,
783	            "robots": [
784	                {
785	                    "robot_id": robot.robot_id,
786	                    "position": list(robot.position),
787	                    "route": [list(cell) for cell in robot.route],
788	                    "task_id": robot.task_id,
789	                    "distance_travelled": robot.distance_travelled,
790	                }
791	                for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id)
792	            ],
793	            "tasks": [
794	                {
795	                    "task_id": task.task_id,
796	                    "pickup": list(task.pickup),
797	                    "dropoff": list(task.dropoff),
798	                    "assigned_robot": task.assigned_robot,
799	                    "picked_up": task.picked_up,
800	                    "completed": task.completed,
801	                }
802	                for task in sorted(self.tasks.values(), key=lambda item: item.task_id)
803	            ],
804	            "replay": copy.deepcopy(self.replay),
805	            "map_changes": copy.deepcopy(self.map_changes),
806	            "paused_tasks": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
807	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
808	        }
809	        payload = (json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
810	
811	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(os.fspath(path))) or os.curdir
812	        fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".checkpoint-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
813	        try:
814	            handle = os.fdopen(fd, "wb")
815	            try:
816	                handle.write(payload)
817	                handle.flush()
818	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
819	            finally:
820	                handle.close()
821	            os.replace(tmp_name, path)
822	            self._fsync_directory(directory)
823	        except BaseException:
824	            # After a successful replace the temp name is already gone.
825	            try:
826	                os.unlink(tmp_name)
827	            except OSError:
828	                pass
829	            raise
830	
831	    @staticmethod
832	    def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
833	        try:
834	            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
835	        except OSError:
836	            return
837	        try:
838	            os.fsync(dir_fd)
839	        except OSError:
840	            pass
841	        finally:
842	            os.close(dir_fd)

844	    @classmethod
845	    def load_checkpoint(cls, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> FleetSimulator:
846	        """Load an independent simulator instance from *path*.
847	
848	        The returned simulator shares no mutable state with the file or any
849	        other loaded instance. Invalid checkpoint content raises
850	        :class:`ValueError` explaining the reason; read/permission failures
851	        propagate as :class:`OSError`.
852	        """
853	        try:
854	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
855	                text = handle.read()
856	        except OSError:
857	            raise
858	        try:
859	            data = json.loads(text)
860	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
861	            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint is not valid JSON: {exc.msg}") from exc
862	        return cls._from_checkpoint(data)
863	
864	    @classmethod
865	    def _from_checkpoint(cls, data: object) -> FleetSimulator:
866	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
867	            raise ValueError("checkpoint root must be a JSON object")
868	
869	        version = data.get("version")
870	        if not _is_int(version):
871	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'version' must be an integer")
872	        if version not in _SUPPORTED_VERSIONS:
873	            raise ValueError(
874	                f"unsupported checkpoint version {version}; supported versions: "
875	                f"{sorted(_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS)}"
876	            )
877	
878	        grid = cls._load_grid(data)
879	        tick = cls._load_tick(data)
880	        robot_records, task_records = cls._load_entities(data)
881	
882	        map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
883	        paused: set[str] = set()
884	        if version == 1:
885	            replay = cls._load_legacy_replay(data)
886	            base_grid = grid
887	        else:
888	            replay = cls._load_replay(data)
889	            map_changes = cls._load_map_changes(data)
890	            paused = cls._load_paused_tasks(data)
891	            base_grid = cls._load_base_grid(data)
892	            if (base_grid.width, base_grid.height) != (grid.width, grid.height):
893	                raise ValueError("base grid dimensions must match the current grid")
894	            cls._validate_map_history(base_grid, grid, map_changes)
895	
896	        robots: list[Robot] = []
897	        for record in robot_records:
898	            position = _as_pair(record["position"], f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position")
899	            if not grid.traversable(position):
900	                raise ValueError(
901	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position {list(position)} is outside "
902	                    "the map or inside an obstacle"
903	                )
904	            route: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
905	            previous = position
906	            for index, cell in enumerate(record["route"]):
907	                waypoint = _as_pair(
908	                    cell, f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {index}"
909	                )
910	                if not grid.traversable(waypoint):
911	                    raise ValueError(
912	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {list(waypoint)} is "
913	                        "outside the map or inside an obstacle"
914	                    )
915	                if abs(waypoint[0] - previous[0]) + abs(waypoint[1] - previous[1]) != 1:
916	                    raise ValueError(
917	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route moves non-adjacently from "
918	                        f"{list(previous)} to {list(waypoint)}"
919	                    )
920	                route.append(waypoint)
921	                previous = waypoint
922	            distance = record["distance_travelled"]
923	            if not _is_int(distance) or distance < 0:
924	                raise ValueError(
925	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} distance_travelled must be a "
926	                    "non-negative integer"
927	                )
928	            robots.append(Robot(record["robot_id"], position, route, record["task_id"], distance))
929	
930	        tasks: list[Task] = []
931	        for record in task_records:
932	            pickup = _as_pair(record["pickup"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} pickup")
933	            dropoff = _as_pair(record["dropoff"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} dropoff")
934	            tasks.append(
935	                Task(
936	                    record["task_id"],
937	                    pickup,
938	                    dropoff,
939	                    record["assigned_robot"],
940	                    record["picked_up"],
941	                    record["completed"],
942	                )
943	            )
944	
945	        robot_by_id = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
946	        task_by_id = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
947	
948	        for robot in robots:
949	            if robot.task_id is not None:
950	                task = task_by_id.get(robot.task_id)
951	                if task is None:
952	                    raise ValueError(
953	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes unknown task {robot.task_id!r}"
954	                    )
955	                if task.completed:
956	                    raise ValueError(
957	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} that is "
958	                        "already completed"
959	                    )
960	                if task.assigned_robot != robot.robot_id:
961	                    raise ValueError(
962	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} but the "
963	                        f"task is assigned to {task.assigned_robot!r}"
964	                    )
965	        for task in tasks:
966	            if task.completed and not task.picked_up:
967	                raise ValueError(f"task {task.task_id!r} is completed but never picked up")
968	            if task.picked_up and task.assigned_robot is None:
969	                raise ValueError(
970	                    f"task {task.task_id!r} is picked up but has no assigned robot"
971	                )
972	            # Completed tasks retain historical ownership; their robots are free
973	            # to take new work, so the mutual binding only holds while a task is
974	            # still in progress.
975	            if not task.completed and task.assigned_robot is not None:
976	                owner = robot_by_id.get(task.assigned_robot)
977	                if owner is None:
978	                    raise ValueError(
979	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} is assigned to unknown robot "
980	                        f"{task.assigned_robot!r}"
981	                    )
982	                if owner.task_id != task.task_id:
983	                    raise ValueError(
984	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} claims robot {owner.robot_id!r} but the "
985	                        f"robot executes {owner.task_id!r}"
986	                    )
987	
988	        cls._validate_paused_state(paused, task_by_id, robot_by_id, grid)
989	        traffic_waits = cls._load_traffic_waits(data, robot_by_id)
990	
991	        replay_change_frames = cls._replay_map_change_frames(replay)
992	        if replay_change_frames != map_changes:
993	            raise ValueError("replay map-change frames do not match 'map_changes' history")
994	
995	        simulator = cls(grid, robots, tasks)
996	        simulator.base_grid = base_grid
997	        simulator.tick = tick
998	        simulator.replay = copy.deepcopy(replay)
999	        simulator.map_changes = copy.deepcopy(map_changes)
1000	        simulator._map_sequence = len(map_changes)
1001	        simulator.paused_tasks = set(paused)
1002	        simulator._traffic_waits = traffic_waits
1003	        # Version 1 has no edit history: its saved grid is the baseline and
1004	        # applies to every tick frame. Version 2 replays the recorded changes
1005	        # alongside the frames so each frame is judged against its contemporary
1006	        # map.
1007	        cls._validate_replay_positions(replay, tick, robot_by_id, base_grid, map_changes)
1008	        return simulator

1013	            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint is missing required field {field_name!r}")

1016	    @classmethod
1017	    def _load_grid(cls, data: Mapping[str, object]) -> GridMap:
1018	        raw = cls._require_field(data, "grid")
1019	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
1020	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'grid' must be an object")
1021	        width = raw.get("width")
1022	        height = raw.get("height")
1023	        if not _is_int(width) or width <= 0:
1024	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid width must be a positive integer")
1025	        if not _is_int(height) or height <= 0:
1026	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid height must be a positive integer")
1027	        raw_obstacles = raw.get("obstacles")
1028	        if not isinstance(raw_obstacles, list):
1029	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid 'obstacles' must be a list")
1030	        obstacles: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
1031	        for index, cell in enumerate(raw_obstacles):
1032	            obstacle = _as_pair(cell, f"obstacle entry {index}")
1033	            if not (0 <= obstacle[0] < width and 0 <= obstacle[1] < height):
1034	                raise ValueError(f"obstacle {list(obstacle)} lies outside the map")
1035	            obstacles.add(obstacle)
1036	        try:
1037	            return GridMap(width, height, frozenset(obstacles))
1038	        except ValueError as exc:
1039	            raise ValueError(f"invalid checkpoint grid: {exc}") from exc

1073	    @classmethod
1074	    def _load_entities(
1075	        cls, data: Mapping[str, object]
1076	    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[dict[str, object]]]:
1077	        raw_robots = cls._require_field(data, "robots")
1078	        raw_tasks = cls._require_field(data, "tasks")
1079	        if not isinstance(raw_robots, list):
1080	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'robots' must be a list")
1081	        if not isinstance(raw_tasks, list):
1082	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'tasks' must be a list")

1161	        changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []

1163	        last_sequence = 0
1164	        for index, frame in enumerate(raw):
1165	            context = f"map change {index}"
1166	            if not isinstance(frame, dict):
1167	                raise ValueError(f"{context} must be an object")
1168	            tick = frame.get("tick")
1169	            sequence = frame.get("sequence")
1170	            if not _is_int(tick) or tick < 0:

1172	            if not _is_int(sequence) or sequence <= 0:
1173	                raise ValueError(f"{context} field 'sequence' must be a positive integer")

1178	                )

1194	                )

1196	                {
1197	                    "type": "map_change",
1198	                    "tick": tick,
1199	                    "sequence": sequence,
1200	                    "added": [list(cell) for cell in added],

1208	    @classmethod
1209	    def _validate_map_history(
1210	        cls,
1211	        base_grid: GridMap,
1212	        saved_grid: GridMap,
1213	        changes: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
1214	    ) -> None:
1215	        obstacles = set(base_grid.obstacles)
1216	        width, height = saved_grid.width, saved_grid.height
1217	        for frame in changes:
1218	            for key in ("added", "removed"):
1219	                for cell in frame[key]:
1220	                    x, y = cell
1221	                    if not (0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height):
1222	                        raise ValueError(
1223	                            f"map change {frame['sequence']} cell {list(cell)} lies "
1224	                            "outside the map"
1225	                        )
1226	            added = {tuple(cell) for cell in frame["added"]}
1227	            removed = {tuple(cell) for cell in frame["removed"]}
1228	            for cell in added:
1229	                if cell in obstacles:
1230	                    raise ValueError(
1231	                        f"map change {frame['sequence']} adds obstacle {list(cell)} "
1232	                        "that is already present according to the history"
1233	                    )
1234	            for cell in removed:
1235	                if cell not in obstacles:
1236	                    raise ValueError(
1237	                        f"map change {frame['sequence']} removes obstacle {list(cell)} "
1238	                        "that is absent according to the history"
1239	                    )
1240	            obstacles |= added
1241	            obstacles -= removed
1242	        if obstacles != set(saved_grid.obstacles):
1243	            raise ValueError(
1244	                "the map reproduced from 'map_changes' does not match the saved grid"
1245	            )

1473	    @classmethod
1474	    def _validate_replay_positions(
1475	        cls,
1476	        replay: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
1477	        tick: int,
1478	        robot_by_id: Mapping[str, Robot],
1479	        base_grid: GridMap,
1480	        changes: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]] = (),
1481	    ) -> None:
1482	        """Reject history that the simulator could never have produced.
1483	
1484	        Every tick frame is checked against the map in effect *during* that
1485	        tick: positions must be in bounds and traversable, no two robots may
1486	        share a cell, each robot may only wait or step one orthogonal cell
1487	        between consecutive tick frames, two robots may not swap cells within
1488	        one tick, and ``moved`` must list exactly the robots whose positions
1489	        changed.
1490	
1491	        Version 2 map changes take effect after the tick they are stamped on,
1492	        in their recorded order: the frame for tick *t* is judged against the
1493	        base grid plus every change stamped below *t*, then the changes stamped
1494	        *t* are applied and may not add obstacles onto cells frame *t* shows a
1495	        robot on -- even when a later change of the same tick removes the cell
1496	        again. Tick-0 changes precede the first frame. Adjacency is always
1497	        judged between neighboring tick frames; a map change between them never
1498	        moves a robot.
1499	
1500	        Version 1 files pass no changes, so the saved grid governs every frame.
1501	        The first frame has no recorded predecessor: its cells, overlaps and
1502	        ``moved`` ids are still checked, but neither the distance of the first
1503	        moves nor the first ``moved`` list is second-guessed.
1504	        """
1505	        tick_frames = [frame for frame in replay if frame.get("type") == "tick"]
1506	        if len(tick_frames) != tick:
1507	            raise ValueError(
1508	                f"replay has {len(tick_frames)} tick frames but the checkpoint is at tick {tick}"
1509	            )
1510	
1511	        expected_ids = set(robot_by_id)
1512	
1513	        def frame_positions(frame: Mapping[str, object]) -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]:
1514	            raw = frame["robots"]
1515	            assert isinstance(raw, dict)
1516	            if set(raw) != expected_ids:
1517	                raise ValueError(
1518	                    f"replay frame {frame['tick']} robot ids do not match current robots"
1519	                )
1520	            return {robot_id: tuple(position) for robot_id, position in raw.items()}
1521	
1522	        # A non-zero-tick history must end exactly where the saved robots stand
1523	        # before any deeper history check runs.
1524	        if tick > 0:
1525	            last_positions = frame_positions(tick_frames[-1])
1526	            for robot_id, position in last_positions.items():
1527	                if position != robot_by_id[robot_id].position:
1528	                    raise ValueError(
1529	                        "last replay frame positions do not match current robot positions "
1530	                        f"for robot {robot_id!r}"
1531	                    )
1532	
1533	        obstacles = set(base_grid.obstacles)
1534	        width, height = base_grid.width, base_grid.height
1535	        change_index = 0
1536	
1537	        def apply_changes(stamp: int, occupants: Mapping[Position, str]) -> None:
1538	            """Apply every change stamped *stamp*, rejecting adds on robots.
1539	
1540	            *occupants* maps a cell to the robot sitting on it when that tick
1541	            ended; it is empty for tick-0 edits once ticks have already run,
1542	            because the unrecorded initial layout cannot be reconstructed.
1543	            """
1544	            nonlocal change_index
1545	            while change_index < len(changes) and changes[change_index]["tick"] == stamp:
1546	                change = changes[change_index]
1547	                sequence = change["sequence"]
1548	                added = {tuple(cell) for cell in change["added"]}
1549	                for cell in added:
1550	                    robot_id = occupants.get(cell)
1551	                    if robot_id is not None:
1552	                        when = (
1553	                            "the initial layout before tick 1"
1554	                            if stamp == 0
1555	                            else f"tick frame {stamp}"
1556	                        )
1557	                        raise ValueError(
1558	                            f"map change {sequence} (after tick {stamp}) adds obstacle "
1559	                            f"{list(cell)} occupied by robot {robot_id!r} in {when}"
1560	                        )
1561	                obstacles.update(added)
1562	                obstacles.difference_update(
1563	                    {tuple(cell) for cell in change["removed"]}
1564	                )
1565	                change_index += 1
1566	
1567	        # Tick-0 edits happened before the first recorded frame. When the
1568	        # checkpoint is still at tick 0 the saved robot positions *are* the
1569	        # layout of that moment; otherwise they cannot be reconstructed.
1570	        initial_occupants = (
1571	            {robot.position: robot.robot_id for robot in robot_by_id.values()}
1572	            if tick == 0
1573	            else {}
1574	        )
1575	        apply_changes(0, initial_occupants)
1576	
1577	        previous: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] | None = None
1578	        for frame in tick_frames:
1579	            frame_tick = frame["tick"]
1580	            # The grid here still reflects only changes stamped below this
1581	            # tick -- exactly the map the robots moved on during this tick.
1582	            positions = frame_positions(frame)
1583	            grid = GridMap(width, height, frozenset(obstacles))
1584	
1585	            for robot_id, position in positions.items():
